guideContent.strategyOverview: Namor turns every blue pip in a noncreature spell into a 1/1 Merfolk — and his own power equals your Merfolk count, so the engine feeds the commander directly. The deck maximizes spell velocity: twelve cantrips and draw spells backed by cheap tutors and graveyard rebuy keep the chain going, thirteen counterspells (nine with double or triple blue pips, each worth multiple tokens) protect the board while fueling it, and Kindred Discovery converts the swarm into cards as it enters and attacks. A light Merfolk lord package turns the 1/1s into a real clock and grows Namor into a commander-damage threat. Win by going wide with pumped tokens, or tall with Namor himself — he flies over stalled boards.

deckCategories.name: Commander Engine
deckCategories.description: Namor converts blue pips on noncreature spells into 1/1 Merfolk tokens that raise his own power. Double-pip spells pay out double.

deckCategories.name: Merfolk Lords & Typal
deckCategories.description: Anthems and typal engines that turn the token swarm into a clock. Harbinger makes every nonbasic an Island so the lords' islandwalk is live against everyone, and Aquitect's Will floods a basic-land defender's turf to switch it on there too; Lullmage converts counterspells into bodies; Kopala and Svyelun protect the board; Mist Dancer lifts the whole school into the air for when islandwalk isn't live; Merrow Commerce untaps the school every end step, turning alpha-strike tokens into blockers and re-arming Lullmage's tap-seven counter.

deckCategories.name: Token & Spell Payoffs
deckCategories.description: Engines that convert spell velocity and token combat into cards and boards. Kindred Discovery (naming Merfolk) draws on every token entering or attacking; Roaming Throne (naming Merfolk) doubles Namor's trigger — two tokens per blue pip; Deeproot Pilgrimage mints an extra Merfolk whenever a nontoken Merfolk taps; Hullbreaker Horror bounces a permanent or spell on every cast.

deckCategories.name: Spell Suite — Draw & Selection
deckCategories.description: Cantrip density keeps spell velocity high; every blue pip is a body. Mystical Tutor and Solve the Equation find the right spell, Treason of Isengard rebuys it, Divergent Equation hauls up to X spent spells back from the graveyard at instant speed, and the convoke draw suite (Harmonized Crescendo, Transcendent Message, Distant Melody) refills off the token board. Quick Study draws two at instant speed, Commander's Insight scales into the late game — three blue pips, three Merfolk, and an extra card per Namor recast — and Aquitect's Will cantrips while flooding a defender's land into an Island for the lords' islandwalk. Harmonized Trio turns the swarm into repeatable Brainstorm casts, and Spirit Water Revival's waterbend mode taps tokens to shuffle the graveyard back and draw seven.

deckCategories.name: Interaction
deckCategories.description: Thirteen counterspells (nine with two or more blue pips — multiple tokens per cast) plus efficient bounce and polymorph removal. Fierce Guardianship is free with Namor out and still mints a Merfolk (a free cast keeps its printed blue pip); Hinder exiles the counter target to the top or bottom of its owner's library, beating recursion and commander-tax dodges. Tishana's Tidebinder flashes in to counter an activated or triggered ability — the one interaction class the counter suite can't touch — and strips the permanent's abilities while it sticks. Cyclonic Rift overloaded is a one-sided board reset; Raise the Palisade naming Merfolk wipes while keeping the army. Interaction is token fuel here, never dead weight.

deckCategories.name: Ramp & Cost Reduction
deckCategories.description: Rocks plus Sapphire Medallion accelerate the commander and widen each turn's spell count. Patchwork Banner doubles as an anthem that pumps Namor himself; Commander's Sphere cashes in for a card when flooded.

synergies.title: Double-pip counterspells = interaction that attacks
synergies.description: Each counterspell with two or more blue pips makes multiple Merfolk off Namor's trigger — holding up interaction still develops the board and grows Namor. Charm and Cryptic mint three each; Counterspell is two bodies for two mana.
